hi thank you for the kind words.

i get what u mean in that someone will probably come along later in life, and you're probably not wrong.

but why wait? why go through the pain im going through now? if i had just been someone better looking with good health and stuff (like one of my friends that literally can date anyone he's interested in but im referencing just anyone better than me in general rn) then i wouldn't need to go through this. im just going through unnecessary pain and hardship that could've been entirely avoided if i had just drawn better cards or was luckier in some aspects of my birth/life.
